turns.text: Hi, I booked a flight this morning by accident and I'd like to cancel it and get my money back.
I can help with that. May I have your booking code and last name, please?
Sure, it's H H five M two U, last name Becker.
Thank you, Mr. Becker, you're verified. I see the Dubai to London flight SK214 on Sunday at 23:55, booked about three hours ago.
Yes, that's the one. Can I get a refund to my card?
Yes, since the booking is under 24 hours old, you're eligible for a refund to your original card. Would you like me to cancel it now?
Done, I've cancelled booking HH5M2U and the full fare is refunded to your original card. To summarize, your SK214 booking is cancelled with a refund to your card.
